entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: A deaf owlin student who signs with a telepathic hearing aid and defends Ajani in the Shattered camp.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A vampire student who wants to beat up Fel and gets caught in a bramble over a commemorative shirt.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A goblin student who spots Lluwen's green smoke signal and conjures a battery of sound during the fight.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who tracks Kirol, is ambushed, and fights Chandra to stop her from attacking the giant archaic.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker, hero of the Multiverse, who leads the Shattered and believes Jace is alive and in her head.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: A Lorwyn elf student whose green smoke signal brings the others and who names the Shattered as the Oriq.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A gorgon student held in the Shattered camp, who later fights vines to restrain Chandra.

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: A grad student trying to calm the chaotic camp at Titan's Grave.

entities.name: Kequia Akosa
entities.description: A student whom Kirol met on the way, whose grandfather is Ajani's friend.

entities.name: Professor Fel
entities.description: A Witherbloom planeswalker professor suspected of being involved with the archaics and who has disappeared.

entities.name: Oracle Jadzi
entities.description: An oracle held in the palm of the giant archaic.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Chandra says is alive and manipulating archaics; Ajani says he is dead.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped with triage when Chandra was hurt on Avishkar.

entities.name: Nissa
entities.description: A planeswalker Ajani asks about.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: A dead planeswalker to whom Ajani compares Jace.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker Ajani suggests might be disguised as Jace.

entities.name: The Shattered
entities.description: Former Oriq pyromancers who broke their masks and refused to attack the school; Chandra took them under her wing.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: A faction that tried to kill everyone at the university.

entities.name: Giant archaic
entities.description: A huge archaic wreathed in star arches that holds Jadzi, is burned by Chandra's fire and tears the ground asunder.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: The forest and dig site in a titan's remains where the camp is in disarray.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Chandra's home plane.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane where Ajani saw Jace's essence unmade.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university that was attacked by the Oriq.

events.summary: Kirol, Abigale and Sanar reunite at the chaotic Titan's Grave dig site to search for Lluwen.
events.quote: Abigale couldn't hear what was going on around her, but she had a pretty good feeling that Kirol was right about that.

events.summary: Ajani catches Kirol and joins the group to help find their friends.
events.quote: You might have been clever enough to sneak away, but I was clever enough to know how to find you.

events.summary: Dina tries to calm the students at the camp as Sanar spots a green smoke signal from Lluwen.
events.quote: That's Lluwen's signal! It must be!

events.summary: Masked figures ambush the group with a wave of concussive magic as they follow the smoke.
events.quote: It was the last thing he managed to say before the whole group got hit with a wave of concussive magic.

events.summary: Ajani wakes bound and finds Chandra Nalaar surrounded by cloaked, mask-wearing figures.
events.quote: Chandra Nalaar stood surrounded on all sides by cloaked figures in masks

events.summary: Chandra says she must make sure Ajani has not been compromised, and Lluwen reveals the masked figures are Oriq.
Chandra explains that the Shattered refused to attack the school and shattered their masks, and she took them under her wing.
events.quote: None of the people here attacked the school, Ajani. They all refused.

events.summary: Chandra tells Ajani that Jace is alive and still inside her head after what he did on Avishkar.
Ajani insists Jace is dead and unmade, upsetting Chandra.
events.quote: He didn't just die; his essence was unmade .

events.summary: Chandra says Jace is manipulating archaics as the giant archaic appears overhead.
Ajani tackles Chandra as she prepares to blast the archaic, and Lluwen spots Jadzi in its palm.
events.quote: Ajani bowled her over and took them both to the ground.

events.summary: Chandra orders the Shattered to keep Ajani's students busy; walls of fire rise and Ajani breaks his bonds.
Ajani and Chandra fight, and he pins her in a hold to stop her attacking.
events.quote: He slipped one arm under her chin and the other hand behind her head.

events.summary: Chandra hurls her gathered fire over their heads and burns the giant archaic, which screams in pain.
events.quote: And before he could stop her, Chandra hurled it over both of their heads.

events.summary: The wounded archaic looks down at Ajani and Chandra and tears the ground asunder.
events.quote: Then it brought its hand down and tore the ground asunder.

relations.note: Old friends; he has looked out for her for years.
relations.quote: Ajani had known Chandra for years—and had looked out for her just as long.

relations.note: She took them under her wing.
relations.quote: I took them under my wing.

relations.note: They broke from the Oriq and refused to attack the school.
relations.quote: Shattered their masks and decided it wasn't for them.

relations.note: She believes Jace did something to her mind.
relations.quote: He did something to me. To my head.
Chandra hurled it over both of their heads.

relations.note: Kirol vouches for him in the Shattered camp.
Jadzi sits in the archaic's palm, protected by a force bubble.
relations.quote: A bubble of force kept Jadzi safe from the flames
